The house:… players are the game's own five opponents, playing as they do in the game except for the clock: here every player has 1000 ms a turn (in the game Nadia takes 1600 ms and Isolde 3000 ms a move).
Tham Mưu and Đại Bàng have three levels each; every level is a player of its own.
No game was lost by forfeit: not one illegal move, error or turn out of time in 77,218 turns.
32 games repeat an earlier game between the same two players with the same colours move for move: players that leave nothing to chance play the same game again.
Every game: battles, the standard line-up of 19 a side. Not in the league: titan-scout.js and counterplay.js, which the notes that came with them call test opponents.
